sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的菜，因为我不太喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com斜杠subscribe上的特惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison.
sentences.zh: FTX创始人萨姆·班克曼-弗里德被判处25年联邦监禁。

sentences.en: When the influential cryptocurrency exchange, FTX, collapsed in 2022.
sentences.zh: 当颇具影响力的加密货币交易所FTX在2022年崩溃时。

sentences.en: It lost billions of dollars in customers' money.
sentences.zh: 它损失了数十亿美元的客户资金。

sentences.en: The man behind one of the biggest financial frauds in American history.
sentences.zh: 美国历史上最大金融欺诈案之一背后的男人。

sentences.en: Lost $10 billion of customer deposits, all while living a relatively lavish lifestyle in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 损失了100亿美元的客户存款，而他自己却在加勒比海过着相对奢华的生活。

sentences.en: Cryptocurrencies have spent the better part of this year in a tailspin, fueled by financial losses.
sentences.zh: 在财务亏损的推动下，加密货币今年大部分时间都在暴跌。

sentences.en: But in a surprising twist earlier this month, those customers were told they would get their money back.
sentences.zh: 但在本月初一个令人惊讶的转折中，这些客户被告知他们将拿回资金。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Yaffe Bellany on what was behind this change in fortune and on what it says about the improbable resurgence of crypto.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·亚菲·贝拉尼将探讨财富命运转变背后的原因，以及它所折射出的加密货币令人意想不到的复苏。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月21日，星期二。

sentences.en: David, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 大卫，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So the last time we spoke, Sam Bankman-Fried, the disgraced founder of the company FTX, and in many ways, you know, the face of the crypto industry,
sentences.zh: 所以我们上次谈话时，名誉扫地的公司FTX创始人萨姆·班克曼-弗里德，在很多方面也是加密货币行业的代言人，

sentences.en: was about to go on trial for stealing money from his customers.
sentences.zh: 正准备因盗窃客户资金而接受审判。

sentences.en: And it really looked like that money was never going to come back.
sentences.zh: 当时看起来那些钱真的永远也拿不回来了。

sentences.en: Billions of dollars disappeared.
sentences.zh: 数十亿美元凭空消失。

sentences.en: But then something surprising happened.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生了意想不到的事。

sentences.en: Tell us about it.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲吧。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: When FTX collapsed, customers were in total despair.
sentences.zh: 当FTX倒闭时，客户们陷入了绝望。

sentences.en: You know, they were convinced they were never going to see this money again.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们坚信自己再也见不到这笔钱了。

sentences.en: And Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud, stealing this money, and sentenced to 25 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德因欺诈和盗窃这些资金而被定罪，并被判处25年监禁。

sentences.en: But after the company collapsed, a team of bankruptcy professionals came in.
sentences.zh: 但公司倒闭后，一队破产专业人士介入了。

sentences.en: These are people whose specialty is going into collapse companies, figuring out what went wrong, and trying to put the pieces back together.
sentences.zh: 这些人专门进驻倒闭的公司，找出问题所在，并试图收拾残局。

sentences.en: And over time, they started cobbling together a pool of assets, investments that Sam had made in other companies, cryptocurrencies that he had stashed over the years.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，他们开始拼凑出一笔资产池，包括萨姆对其他公司的投资，以及他多年来囤积的加密货币。

sentences.en: And as they did this, they built up a large supply of assets.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，他们积累了大量的资产。

sentences.en: And what they announced just a few days ago is that not only are they going to be able to repay customers, but they'll be able to repay them in full with intereSt.
sentences.zh: 他们在几天前宣布，不仅能够偿还客户，而且能够连本带息地全额偿还。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 难以置信。

sentences.en: And this is really a shocking conclusion to this whole saga.
sentences.zh: 这确实给整个事件画上了一个令人震惊的句号。

sentences.en: And it's in line with a few really surprising things that have happened in the crypto industry over the last year or so,
sentences.zh: 这也符合过去一年左右加密货币行业发生的一些非常令人惊奇的事情，

sentences.en: since it reached its low point back in November 2022 with FTX's collapse.
sentences.zh: 自从2022年11月FTX倒闭将其推向低谷以来。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's dig into that.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: Explain to us how this failed company ended up being able to return billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 给我们解释一下，这家破产的公司最终是如何能够归还数十亿美元的。

sentences.en: How did it do that?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: So the first thing that's important to understand is where the money went.
sentences.zh: 首先需要了解的重点是钱去哪儿了。

sentences.en: It wasn't simply vaporized.
sentences.zh: 它并非凭空蒸发了。

sentences.en: Sure, you know, some of it was spent on expensive material possessions, but not all of it.
sentences.zh: 当然，其中一部分被花在了昂贵的物质享受上，但并非全部。

sentences.en: Sam put a lot of this money into investments in other startups, investments in cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 萨姆把这笔钱很大一部分投入了其他初创企业的投资以及加密货币投资中。

sentences.en: And this was stealing.
sentences.zh: 这就是偷窃。

sentences.en: This was money he wasn't supposed to use.
sentences.zh: 这是他本不应该动用的资金。

sentences.en: It was supposed to be set aside for customers.
sentences.zh: 这些钱本该为客户留作准备。

sentences.en: But some of those investments actually turned out to be really good.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些投资实际上结果非常不错。

sentences.en: So give me an example.
sentences.zh: 那么给个例子吧。

sentences.en: What turned out well?
sentences.zh: 什么结果很好？

sentences.en: One of Sam Bankman-Fried's pet issues was artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德特别关注的议题之一就是人工智能。

sentences.en: He was obsessed with AI.
sentences.zh: 他对人工智能着了迷。

sentences.en: He was convinced that it was a potential threat to civilization.
sentences.zh: 他确信这是对文明的潜在威胁。

sentences.en: And his version of a solution to that problem was to invest in AI companies that were committed to developing the technology responsibly.
sentences.zh: 他对这个问题的解决方案就是投资那些致力于负责任地开发这项技术的人工智能公司。

sentences.en: And so one of the companies that he invested in was called Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 他投资的一家公司名叫Anthropic。

sentences.en: And he put in about $500 million in 2021.
sentences.zh: 他在2021年投入了大约5亿美元。

sentences.en: Now, over the last three years, the AI industry has exploded.
sentences.zh: 如今，在过去三年里，人工智能行业呈爆炸式增长。

sentences.en: And companies like Anthropic have become much, much more valuable.
sentences.zh: 像Anthropic这样的公司变得极其有价值。

sentences.en: And so just in the last few months, those bankruptcy experts who are now running FTX sold off a portion of that stake for close to a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几个月里，现在负责运营FTX的破产专家以近10亿美元的价格出售了其中一部分股权。

sentences.en: So that's a tidy profit on the investment that FTX initially made.
sentences.zh: 所以这对FTX最初的投资来说是一笔相当可观的利润。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So part of the explanation is AI and kind of riding the AI wave.
sentences.zh: 所以部分解释是人工智能以及顺应人工智能浪潮。

sentences.en: What about all of the money FTX had in cryptocurrencies?
sentences.zh: 那FTX拥有的所有加密货币资金呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it was an exchange for cryptocurrencies after all.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它毕竟是一个加密货币交易所。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, in theory, FTX was supposed to be sitting on a huge number of cryptocurrencies because that's what people were storing on the platform.
sentences.zh: 对，理论上讲，FTX本应持有大量的加密货币，因为那是人们储存在平台上的东西。

sentences.en: And it turned out that a lot of those assets had disappeared or they'd been converted into other cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 结果证明，许多此类资产已经消失，或者被转换为其他加密货币。

sentences.en: And so it wasn't as simple as the Bitcoin that you'd stored on the platform was still there.
sentences.zh: 因此，事情并不像你存在平台上的比特币依然完好无损那么简单。

sentences.en: But one cryptocurrency that Bankman-Fried maintained a large supply of was called Solana.
sentences.zh: 但班克曼-弗里德保留了大量储备的一种加密货币叫做Solana。

sentences.en: You know, back when FTX collapsed, Solana was trading at something like under $20 per token, really at a low.
sentences.zh: 你知道，回想FTX倒闭时，Solana的交易价格大约在每个代币20美元以下，处于真正的低谷。

sentences.en: But since the collapse, Solana has surged again.
sentences.zh: 但自倒闭以来，Solana再次飙升。

sentences.en: And in March, it hit about $200.
sentences.zh: 并在3月份达到了约200美元。

sentences.en: And the estate sold a large quantity of it and generated billions of dollars to return to creditors from that sale.
sentences.zh: 破产资产管理机构出售了大量该代币，通过这笔出售产生了数十亿美元以返还给债权人。

sentences.en: And the rise in Solana is really part of a larger story in the crypto market,
sentences.zh: Solana的崛起其实是加密货币市场更大故事的一部分，

sentences.en: a resurgence that's happened over the last year that's really shocked people and has sent these volatile assets back to some of their all-time highs.
sentences.zh: 这是过去一年发生的一场复苏，确实让人们大跌眼镜，并将这些高波动性资产推回了历史最高点附近。

sentences.en: Okay, so essentially, it's the crypto market that's going to give FTX customers their money back, at least in part.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以本质上是加密货币市场将把资金返还给FTX客户，至少是部分返还。

sentences.en: There's been this upswing in the pendulum in recent months, and that is what accounts for this reversal of fortune.
sentences.zh: 最近几个月市场天平出现了回摆，这正是财富命运逆转的原因。

sentences.en: But explain to me how that's possible, how that's happened with crypto.
sentences.zh: 但请向我解释一下这怎么可能，加密货币怎么会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: I mean, the last time we talked, crypto was really down for the count.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们上次谈话时，加密货币真的已经一蹶不振了。

sentences.en: So it's a combination of factors.
sentences.zh: 这是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sentences.en: One is a kind of perception within the crypto industry that the bad actors have been washed out.
sentences.zh: 一是加密货币行业内部有一种看法，即害群之马已经被清洗掉了。

sentences.en: Sam Baikman-Fried is in jail.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·拜克曼-弗里德在狱中。

sentences.en: He's serving his sentence.
sentences.zh: 他在服刑。

sentences.en: Changpeng Zhao, who's the chief executive of another troubled crypto company, Binance, also just got sentenced to prison time.
sentences.zh: 另一家陷入困境的加密货币公司币安（Binance）的首席执行官赵长鹏也刚刚被判入狱。

sentences.en: And so there's this feeling, you know, right or wrong in the crypto industry that a new chapter is beginning and that the bad guys are out of the picture.
sentences.zh: 因此，加密货币行业有一种感觉，无论对错，新篇章正在开启，坏蛋已经出局了。

sentences.en: But the real driver of this kind of market-wide surge is Bitcoin, the original, most important, most valuable cryptocurrency.
sentences.zh: 但这种全市场飙升的真正驱动力是比特币，这个最初的、最重要的、最具价值的加密货币。

sentences.en: And the cause of the surge is a recent court case.
sentences.zh: 而飙升的原因是一场最近的法庭诉讼。

sentences.en: The outcome of this case has essentially brought Bitcoin into the heart of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这起案件的结果基本上将比特币带入了美国经济的中心，

sentences.en: economy and mainstreamed it in a way that it's never been before.
sentences.zh: 并以前所未有的方式使其主流化。

sentences.en: So tell me about this case.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我讲讲这个案子吧。

sentences.en: So the case involves a crypto company called Grayscale.
sentences.zh: 这个案子涉及一家名为灰度（Grayscale）的加密货币公司。

sentences.en: And what Grayscale wanted to do was offer a Bitcoin ETF.
sentences.zh: 灰度想要做的是提供比特币ETF。

sentences.en: That's an exchange-traded fund, which is essentially a basket of assets that somebody can invest in.
sentences.zh: 也就是交易所交易基金，本质上就是别人可以投资的一篮子资产。

sentences.en: Instead of investing in the assets themselves directly, you're investing in the basket that contains the assets.
sentences.zh: 你不是直接投资资产本身，而是投资包含这些资产的篮子。

sentences.en: So it's a little bit indirect.
sentences.zh: 所以这稍微有点间接。

sentences.en: And in the case of Bitcoin, it would mean you could just go onto your brokerage account and buy a share in a basket of Bitcoin.
sentences.zh: 就比特币而言，这意味着你可以直接登录你的经纪账户，购买一篮子比特币中的份额。

sentences.en: You don't have to worry about downloading an online wallet and figuring out the complications of cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 你无需担心下载在线钱包并弄懂加密货币的复杂性。

sentences.en: This was a way to open up the possibility of Bitcoin investment to more people.
sentences.zh: 这是向更多人敞开比特币投资可能性的途径。

sentences.en: But the federal government was very resistant to this.
sentences.zh: 但联邦政府对此非常抵制。

sentences.en: You know, ETFs are a pillar of the mainstream financial system.
sentences.zh: 你知道，ETF是主流金融体系的支柱。

sentences.en: They're a vehicle where people store their retirement savings and other crucial investments.
sentences.zh: 它们是人们存入退休储蓄和其他关键投资的载体。

sentences.en: And the federal government basically said, this is too risky.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府基本上表示，这太危险了。

sentences.en: We don't want people's money to be locked up in this market that is super volatile and that just over the last couple of years has plunged significantly.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望人们的资金被锁在这个超级动荡、且在过去几年里大幅暴跌的市场中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it just had this massive crash recently, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它最近才刚刚经历了一次大崩盘，对吧？

sentences.en: So you wouldn't really think that, like, putting these things directly into American retirement accounts would be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的不会认为把这些东西直接放进美国退休账户是个好主意。

sentences.en: So it makes sense to me that the government objects.
sentences.zh: 因此政府反对对我来说是合情合理的。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's a huge buildup to the resolution of this case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个案件的裁决酝酿了很久。

sentences.en: Financial giant Fidelity now entering a new crypto race on Wall Street over these Bitcoin ETFs.
sentences.zh: 金融巨头富达（Fidelity）现在正进军华尔街围绕这些比特币ETF的新加密货币竞赛。

sentences.en: While this case is pending, a bunch of other companies jump on board and apply to offer their own Bitcoin ETFs.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件审理期间，一帮其他公司纷纷加入并申请推出他们自己的比特币ETF。

sentences.en: And that includes pillars of the mainstream financial system that have generally been cautious about dealing with digital assets.
sentences.zh: 这其中包括一向在处理数字资产时保持谨慎的主流金融体系支柱。

sentences.en: Asset management giant BlackRock took the first steps yesterday to launch a spot.
sentences.zh: 资产管理巨头贝莱德（BlackRock）昨天迈出了推出现货的第一步。

sentences.en: Kick up a sudden Floria of activity, a race, if you will, to file these spot.
sentences.zh: 掀起了一阵突如其来的狂热活动，可以说是一场争相申请这些现货的竞赛。

sentences.en: The whole crypto industry is watching.
sentences.zh: 整个加密货币行业都在关注。

sentences.en: It's considered very, very crucial.
sentences.zh: 这被认为非常非常关键。

sentences.en: Wall Street is getting invited in anticipation of the greatest show on earth.
sentences.zh: 华尔街正翘首以盼这场地球上最伟大的表演。

sentences.en: And so everyone in the industry is waiting to see what the court will do.
sentences.zh: 因此行业中的每个人都在等待看法院会怎么做。

sentences.en: And finally, the ruling arrives in AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 最后裁决在8月下达。

sentences.en: We're following new developments in the crypto world today as a U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们今天在关注加密货币世界的新动向，因为一家美国联邦法院为史上首个比特币ETF铺平了道路。

sentences.en: federal court paves the way for the first ever Bitcoin ETF.
sentences.zh: 而行业赢了。

sentences.en: And the industry wins.
sentences.zh: 加密货币行业的历史性时刻在今天发生。

sentences.en: The watershed moment for the crypto industry happening today.
sentences.zh: 比特币ETF预计将在大约两小时后开始交易。

sentences.en: Bitcoin ETFs set to begin trading in just about two hours from now.
sentences.zh: 法院基本上裁定，美国证交会（SEC）未能履行举证责任，证明这些投资产品不应被允许。

sentences.en: The court finds, essentially, that the SEC has failed to meet its burden to show that these investment products shouldn't be allowed.
sentences.zh: 证明它们对投资大众是不安全的。

sentences.en: That they're unsafe for the investing public.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在1月，美国证交会有些勉强地说，好吧，你知道的，我们形势逼人。

sentences.en: And what that means is that in January, the SEC kind of grudgingly says, OK, you know, our hand has been forced.
sentences.zh: 这些公司可以去推出比特币ETF了。

sentences.en: And these companies can go out and offer Bitcoin ETFs.
sentences.zh: 因此ETF不久后便开始交易。

sentences.en: And so the ETFs start trading shortly after.
sentences.zh: 并且它们变得非常非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And they become really, really popular.
sentences.zh: 摩根大通指出，目前流入这些ETF的资金总额已达200亿美元。

sentences.en: JP Morgan points out there's now been a total of $20 billion of inflows into these ETFs.
sentences.zh: 这还不包括……

sentences.en: That's excluding...
sentences.zh: 人们似乎对将自己的储蓄投入这些投资工具表现出极大的热情。

sentences.en: People are seemingly very enthusiastic about putting their savings into these investment vehicles.
sentences.zh: 富达、贝莱德以及其他提供这些产品的公司必须购买大量的比特币来支撑这些投资产品。

sentences.en: Fidelity and BlackRock and the other companies that are offering them have to buy lots of Bitcoin in order to support these investment offerings.
sentences.zh: 结果就是……

sentences.en: And as a result...
sentences.zh: 加密货币比特币的价值在今天飙升至历史最高点。

sentences.en: The value of the cryptocurrency Bitcoin raced to an all-time high today.
sentences.zh: 比特币价格飙升。

sentences.en: Bitcoin's price surges.

sentences.zh: 它触及了历史最高纪录，大约是70,000美元。

sentences.en: It hits its all-time record, which is about $70,000.
sentences.zh: 记住，在一年半前的2022年11月，这还是一种跌破20,000美元的资产。

sentences.en: And remember, this was an asset that was dipping below $20,000 back a year and a half ago in November 2022.
sentences.zh: 所以这真是一次惊人的飙升。

sentences.en: And so it's just an amazing surge.
sentences.zh: 因此，富达和贝莱德突然开始交易这些以比特币为核心的投资工具、也就是这些ETF。

sentences.en: So suddenly, Fidelity and BlackRock are trading these investment vehicles, these ETFs, with Bitcoin at the heart of them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着比特币不再是边缘资产。

sentences.en: Which means that Bitcoin is no longer fringe.
sentences.zh: 这意味着比特币不再是边缘资产。

sentences.en: It's mainstream.
sentences.zh: 它成了主流。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And this is a huge change because during the last crypto collapse,
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个巨大的改变，因为在上一次加密货币崩盘期间，

sentences.en: one thing that was striking about it was that people who worked in the crypto industry or had investments in crypto, they suffered as a result.
sentences.zh: 当时最让人印象深刻的是，那些在加密货币行业工作或投资加密货币的人，他们因此蒙受了损失。

sentences.en: But the rest of the economy was basically walled off.
sentences.zh: 但其余的经济体基本上是隔离开来的。

sentences.en: The fact that Bitcoin lost almost all of its value in a year, that didn't affect normal people because most normal people didn't own Bitcoin.
sentences.zh: 比特币在一年内几乎价值归零，这并没有影响到普通人，因为大多数普通人并不拥有比特币。

sentences.en: And so what this change has done is set the stage for Bitcoin to essentially affect a much broader swath of the population.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种改变所做的一切，为比特币最终影响更广泛的人群奠定了基础。

sentences.en: And the precedent set by this major victory in the introduction of Bitcoin ETFs is maybe the crypto industry can get what it wants.
sentences.zh: 随着比特币 ETF 的推出取得这一重大胜利，所开创的先例或许意味着加密货币行业能够如愿以偿。

sentences.en: Maybe it can defeat the federal government and really intersect with every other part of the mainstream economy.
sentences.zh: 也许它能战胜联邦政府，并真正与主流经济的每一个其他部分交织在一起。

sentences.en: Which is pretty remarkable considering where it was just two years ago.
sentences.zh: 考虑到它仅仅在两年前的处境，这相当了不起。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, we were at a point where people were declaring that crypto is dead.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们曾处于这样一个地步：人们宣称加密货币已死。

sentences.en: That always sounded a little bit premature to me.
sentences.zh: 这在我听来总是显得有点为时过早。

sentences.en: But the turnaround we've seen over the last year is nothing that anyone ever expected.
sentences.zh: 但我们在过去一年里看到的转机是任何人都未曾预料到的。

sentences.en: And this time, the stakes are even higher.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，赌注甚至更高了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》字谜游戏之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天都创作“拼字蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和 Letterboxd 游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到那些声音的主人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: So crypto, as it turns out, is not dead.
sentences.zh: 所以事实证明，加密货币并没有死。

sentences.en: And in fact, it's no longer even fringe, right?
sentences.zh: 事实上，它甚至不再是边缘事物了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's mainstream.
sentences.zh: 它是主流。

sentences.en: What does that mean, David, for the next time there's a big crypto crash?
sentences.zh: 大卫，对于下一次加密货币大崩盘来说，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm assuming the federal government is going to feel some pressure to be on the hook for it because these aren't just speculative internet investments, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我假设联邦政府会感到一些压力，不得不为此承担责任，因为这些不仅仅是投机性的互联网投资，对吧？

sentences.en: They're solid retirement investments for average Americans.
sentences.zh: 它们是普通美国人稳健的退休投资。

sentences.en: So there are two schools of thought on this and how it could go.
sentences.zh: 所以关于这一点以及它将如何发展，主要有两种截然不同的看法。

sentences.en: If you ask a crypto proponent, they would point out that even though crypto has endured these sort of boom and bust cycles over the years, the overall trend is up.
sentences.zh: 如果你问加密货币的支持者，他们会指出，尽管加密货币多年来经历了这些繁荣与萧条的周期，但总体趋势是向上的。

sentences.en: You know, if you bought Bitcoin 10 years ago, you've seen massive gains.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你在 10 年前买入比特币，你已经获得了巨大的收益。

sentences.en: And so giving more Americans a way to access that asset is a potentially positive thing.
sentences.zh: 因此，为更多的美国人提供一种接触该资产的途径可能是一件积极的事情。

sentences.en: That's the industry argument.
sentences.zh: 这就是行业的论点。

sentences.en: But certainly there are a lot of people who are really, really concerned about this because last time crypto crashed, the rest of the economy, the mainstream economy,
sentences.zh: 但当然，有很多人对此感到非常非常担忧，因为上一次加密货币崩盘时，其余的经济体，即主流经济，

sentences.en: was essentially walled off.
sentences.zh: 基本上是隔离开来的。

sentences.en: If you owned crypto and you'd experimented with digital currencies, in some cases you lost all your savings and really suffered.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有加密货币并且尝试过数字货币，在某些情况下你失去了所有的积蓄并遭受了沉重打击。

sentences.en: But everybody else, you know, they might not even have noticed.
sentences.zh: 但其他人，你知道，他们甚至可能根本没有注意到。

sentences.en: And that could change.
sentences.zh: 这种情况可能会改变。

sentences.en: I mean, now that the Bitcoin ETFs are rising in popularity, you know, more and more people are likely to be connected to this volatile industry.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在随着比特币 ETF 的普及，你知道，越来越多的人可能会与这个波动剧烈的行业联系在一起。

sentences.en: And so another downturn could ultimately harm a much broader swath of the population.
sentences.zh: 因此，下一次低迷最终可能会损害更广泛的人群。

sentences.en: So a bigger chance for contagion to the rest of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果加密货币出现问题，

sentences.en: economy should something go wrong with crypto.
sentences.zh: 美国其余经济体受到传染的几率就会更大。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, is the ETF alone going to bring down the American economy?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅凭 ETF 就能摧毁美国经济吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 可能不会。

sentences.en: But it's a first step in the direction of a kind of more systemic risk.
sentences.zh: 但这是朝著某种更具系统性风险的方向迈出的第一步。

sentences.en: Okay, so what are we really looking at here?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么我们在这里真正看到的是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, now that these Bitcoin ETFs have been approved, are we looking at a future where other forms of crypto enter the mainstream as well?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在这些比特币 ETF 已经获得批准，我们是否正在迎来一个未来，即其他形式的加密货币也将进入主流？

sentences.en: There's actually a broader legal battle that's going on between the federal government and the industry.
sentences.zh: 事实上，联邦政府与该行业之间正在进行一场更大规模的法律斗争。

sentences.en: You know, the SEC is arguing in all sorts of court cases that a cryptocurrency is no different from, you know, stock, essentially, like a share in a company that you might buy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国证券交易委员会在各种诉讼中辩称，加密货币与你可能购买的公司的股票本质上没有区别，

sentences.en: And that it should be regulated like that, meaning that someone can't just create a new cryptocurrency and start selling it.
sentences.zh: 并且它应该受到类似的监管，这意味着某人不能随随便便创造一种新的加密货币并开始出售它。

sentences.en: It has to be properly registered.
sentences.zh: 它必须经过适当的注册。

sentences.en: They have to make all sorts of disclosures associated with this product.
sentences.zh: 他们必须披露与该产品相关的所有类型的信息。

sentences.en: All of those rules that apply to public companies that are trading their shares on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 所有这些适用于在华尔街交易其股票的上市公司的规则。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the agency frames this as a matter of investor protection.
sentences.zh: 该机构将此界定为投资者保护的问题。

sentences.en: This is how you ensure people know what they're buying when they kind of get into this weird and volatile industry.
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何确保人们在涉足这个怪异且动荡的行业时，知道自己买的是什么。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Crypto people are opposed to that, and they have a few different visions of how the industry should actually be regulated.
sentences.zh: 加密货币界的人士对此表示反对，他们对该行业应该如何监管有几种不同的设想。

sentences.en: In one version,
sentences.zh: 在其中一种设想中，

sentences.en: they kind of compare cryptocurrencies to collectibles like Beanie Babies or trading cards and say that the way in which a cryptocurrency accrues value over time is more akin to that than to,
sentences.zh: 他们将加密货币比作豆豆娃娃（Beanie Babies）或集换式卡牌等收藏品，并称加密货币随着时间推移增值的方式更类似于此，而不是

sentences.en: you know, shares in a company that rise in value.
sentences.zh: 你知道，像价值上升的公司股份那样。

sentences.en: Some say we need entirely new rules.
sentences.zh: 有些人说我们需要全新的规则。

sentences.en: Congress should start from scratch and come up with a new system just for governing cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 国会应该从头开始，专门为管理加密货币想出一个新的系统。

sentences.en: So essentially, this is a very big new battle.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，这是一场非常重大的新战斗。

sentences.en: The government's saying the Wild West needs a sheriff, but we still don't know if it's going to get one, right, if it's going to prevail.
sentences.zh: 政府说蛮荒西部需要一个治安官，但我们仍然不知道它是否会迎来一个，对吧，不知道它是否会胜出。

sentences.en: Well, the government is trying to be that sheriff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，政府正试图成为那个治安官。

sentences.en: It is actively suing a whole bunch of crypto companies, including some of the biggest in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它正在积极起诉一大批加密货币公司，其中包括美国最大的一些公司。

sentences.en: The most obvious example is Coinbase, the largest U.S.
sentences.zh: 最明显的例子就是 Coinbase，这家目前正被美国证券交易委员会起诉的美国最大加密货币公司。

sentences.en: crypto company currently getting sued by the SEC.
sentences.zh: 这里潜在的结果对这些公司来说真的是极具破坏性的。

sentences.en: And the potential outcome here is really, really damaging for these companies.
sentences.zh: 政府认为它们一直作为非法的证券交易所运营。

sentences.en: The government is arguing that they've been operating as illegal securities exchanges.
sentences.zh: 如果政府获胜，我们可能会看到巨额罚款，其规模甚至足以让其中一些公司破产。

sentences.en: And if the government prevails, we could see massive fines on such a scale that they could even bankrupt some of these companies.
sentences.zh: 而最终的结果将是加密货币被驱逐出美国，公司向海外转移，所有那些带着狗名字的怪异初创公司重新安置到新加坡，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: And the ultimate outcome there is crypto getting driven out of the U.S., companies moving offshore, all those weird startups with dog names relocating to Singapore or, you know,
sentences.zh: 任何碰巧当月大受欢迎的司法管辖区。

sentences.en: whatever jurisdiction happens to be flavor of the month.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在某种程度上已经看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And in fact, we're already seeing that to some extent.
sentences.zh: 一些担心事情会如何发展的加密货币初创公司已经开始逃离美国。

sentences.en: There has been a flight from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但随后还有另一种情况，也就是比特币 ETF 的胜利几乎为我们预演过的那种情况，即加密货币行业实际上赢了。

sentences.en: by a few crypto startups that are kind of worried about how this might work out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，联邦政府无法证明这些数字货币应该像证券一样受到监管。

sentences.en: But then there's another scenario, the one that the Bitcoin ETF victory almost previewed for us, where the crypto industry actually wins.
sentences.zh: 该行业在美国蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: You know, the federal government is unable to prove that these digital currencies should be regulated like securities.
sentences.zh: 它变得越来越主流。

sentences.en: And the industry flourishes in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而普通的美国人开始将他们的积蓄倾注其中。

sentences.en: It becomes more and more mainstream.
sentences.zh: 这再次显得相当冒险。

sentences.en: And everyday Americans start pouring their savings into it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个重大、重大的风险。

sentences.en: Which, again, seems quite risky.
sentences.zh: 甚至在今年 1 月美国证券交易委员会批准比特币 ETF 时，美国证券交易委员会主席加里·根斯勒（Gary Gensler）——他是加密货币行业里的大反派，你知道，他

sentences.en: It's definitely a major, major risk.
sentences.zh: 非常反对该行业的这种扩张——

sentences.en: And even when the SEC approved the Bitcoin ETF back in January, Gary Gensler, the SEC chair, who's this huge villain in the crypto industry, he's, you know,
sentences.zh: 他在批准该产品时，附加了各种各样的警告。

sentences.en: very opposed to the kind of expansion of the industry.
sentences.zh: 这些产品很危险。

sentences.en: He kind of couched his approval of this product with all sorts of warnings.
sentences.zh: 比特币的价格一直在上下波动。

sentences.en: These products are dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是行业的一场胜利时刻，却被美国证券交易委员会定性为一次真正的警示事件。

sentences.en: Bitcoin's price goes up and down all of the time.
sentences.zh: 大卫，这将在哪里得出结论？

sentences.en: It was a sort of moment of victory for the industry that was framed by the SEC as this real cautionary episode.
sentences.zh: 这些案件很可能会上诉到最高法院。

sentences.en: Where will this be decided, David?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然很难预测。

sentences.en: These cases are likely to reach the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于一些初步裁决的走向，我认为我们很可能会看到一种分裂的局面，来自不同法官的裁决会存在分歧。

sentences.en: I mean, it's difficult to predict, of course.
sentences.zh: 而这正是那种最终需要最高法院介入的情况。

sentences.en: But given the way some preliminary rulings have gone, I think that we're likely to see a sort of split situation where we have divergent rulings coming from different judges.
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，回到我们谈话的开始，所有这一切都解释了为什么 FTX 的客户能够拿回他们的钱。

sentences.en: And that's the type of scenario where you ultimately need the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这是否应该改变我们对萨姆·班克曼-弗里德（Sam Bankman-Fried）的看法？

sentences.en: So, David, going back to the beginning of our conversation, all of this explains why customers of FTX are going to get their money back.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得他说过他只需要多一点时间来凑钱。

sentences.en: Should this change the way we think about Sam Bankman Freed?
sentences.zh: 然后他遭到了一番嘲笑，接着就锒铛入狱了。

sentences.en: I do remember him saying that he just needed a little bit more time to come up with the money.
sentences.zh: 但现在投资者正在拿回他们的钱，加密货币卷土重来，并且真正进入了状态。

sentences.en: And he was kind of laughed at and then he went to jail.
sentences.zh: 他是对的吗？

sentences.en: But now that investors are getting their money back, crypto is back up and kind of really in the swing of things.
sentences.zh: 我认为萨姆·班克曼-弗里德会很乐意将这个消息宣称为对他的平反时刻，但坦率地说，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Was he right?
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，它其实并没有带来那么大的改变。

sentences.en: I think Sam Bankman Freed would love to claim this news as a moment of vindication for him, but it really isn't, frankly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，客户追回资金这个问题在审判中被提出过。

sentences.en: Legally, it doesn't actually make that much of a difference.
sentences.zh: 而法官基本上所说的是，如果你抢劫了银行，

sentences.zh: 你偷了 1000 美元，然后用这 1000 美元去买彩票，结果中了一百万美元并且能够把钱还给银行，你最初还是抢劫了它。

sentences.en: And what the judge said, basically, was that if you rob the bank,
sentences.zh: 你知道，有现行的法律来防止这种情况，因为大多数情况下你最终并不会中彩票。

sentences.en: you steal $1,000 and you use the $1,000 to buy lottery tickets and you end up with a million dollars and you can repay the bank, you still robbed it in the first place.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这里其实存在另一种历史走向。

sentences.en: You know, there are laws in place preventing that because most of the time you don't end up winning the lottery.
sentences.zh: 在 2022 年 11 月 FTX 没有发生挤兑、公司没有崩溃的情况下，萨姆·班克曼-弗里德所做的所有这些投资，你知道，

sentences.en: On the other hand, there is kind of an alternate history here.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上都获利了。

sentences.en: A version of events where there isn't a bank run on FTX in November of 2022 and the company doesn't collapse in which all of these investments that SBF has made, you know,
sentences.zh: 而他实际上也确实拿回了钱，并能够将钱还给人们。

sentences.en: profit to some degree.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全假设的宇宙，谁知道事情是否会那样发展呢。

sentences.en: And he actually does get the money back and is in a position to repay people.
sentences.zh: 也许他只会偷更多的钱。

sentences.en: It's a totally theoretical universe and who knows if it ever would have played out that way.
sentences.zh: 但事情的发展方式中绝对带有一种莫大的讽刺意味。

sentences.en: Maybe he would have just stolen more money.
sentences.zh: 如果时机稍微不同，你知道，萨姆·班克曼-弗里德历史的整个轨迹都可能会改变。

sentences.en: But there's definitely a certain irony in the way that things have played out.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种讽刺。

sentences.en: If the timing had been slightly different, you know, the whole course of SBF's history could have been changed.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一种讽刺，那就是加密货币行业在过去几个月里所取得的成就，本质上就是萨姆·班克曼-弗里德最初着手去做的事情。

sentences.en: So that's one irony.
sentences.zh: 就像他成为加密货币代言人、出席国会听证会、倡导监管的原因一样，他是想让加密货币走向主流。

sentences.en: But there's also another, which is that what the crypto industry has achieved over the past couple of months is essentially what Sam Bankman-Fried set out to do in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他希望普通美国人能够通过他的平台接触到它。

sentences.en: Like the reason he became the face of crypto, went before Congress, advocated for regulation, is that he wanted crypto to go mainstream.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们算是做到了。

sentences.en: He wanted average Americans to have access to it through his platform.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And now they sort of do.
sentences.zh: 加密货币比以往任何时候都更加重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 它正变得与美国经济更加交织在一起。

sentences.en: Crypto is as important as it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 人们正在把钱重新注入其中。

sentences.en: It's becoming more enmeshed in the American economy.
sentences.zh: 曲线上的数字正在上升。

sentences.en: People are pouring money back in.
sentences.zh: 但我还是要告诫大家，不要仅仅从价格上涨了多少或者 FTX 客户可能拿回多少钱的角度来看待加密货币的成功。

sentences.en: The numbers on the lines are going up.
sentences.zh: 因为加密货币最初是由布道者向公众推销的，他们将其描述为一个应该远不止关乎价格的系统。

sentences.en: But I would caution against seeing crypto's success only in terms of how high the price has gone or how much money FTX's customers might get back.
sentences.zh: 它本应改变金融，彻底革新我们使用资金的方式，你知道，为那些被拒之门外的人提供进入金融体系的途径。

sentences.en: Because crypto was initially sold to the public by evangelists who described it as a system that was supposed to be about a lot more than just price.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，它还没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: It was supposed to transform finance, overhaul how we're using money, you know, offer access to the financial system to people who've been locked out.
sentences.zh: 该行业从未真正生产出被美国人真正作为实用工具接受的产品。

sentences.en: And so far, it just hasn't.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对大多数人来说，这只是一笔投资。

sentences.en: The industry has never actually produced something that Americans really embraced as a practical use.
sentences.zh: 该行业在经济中的角色以潜在危险的方式扩大了。

sentences.en: I mean, for most people, this is just an investment.
sentences.zh: 它做到这一点，却并没有真正解决任何这些问题，也没有回答任何多年来一直悬而未决的疑问。

sentences.en: And the industry's role in the economy has expanded in ways that are potentially dangerous.
sentences.zh: 大卫，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And it's done that without actually solving any of these problems or answering any of these unanswered questions that have lingered for years at this point.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: David, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 周一，

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 世界顶级刑事法院的首席检察官宣布，他正在以反人类罪的罪名寻求对以色列和哈马斯领导人的逮捕令。

sentences.en: On Monday,
sentences.zh: 该请求仍需得到国际刑事法院法官的批准。

sentences.en: the chief prosecutor at the world's top criminal court announced that he was seeking arrest warrants for the leaders of both Israel and Hamas on charges of crimes against humanity.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要几个月的时间。

sentences.en: The request must still be approved by the judges from the International Criminal Court.
sentences.zh: 在周末发生直升机坠毁导致总统和外交部长身亡后，伊朗当局试图展现出一种秩序和镇定的姿态。

sentences.en: And that could take months.
sentences.zh: 该国第一副总统接任代理总统职务，新的总统选举定于 6 月举行。

sentences.en: And Iranian authorities sought to project a sense of order and calm after the deaths of the president and foreign minister in a helicopter crash over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 伊朗官方媒体周一报道称，坠机事故是因为所谓的“技术故障”造成的。

sentences.en: The country's first vice president assumed the role as acting president, and new presidential elections were scheduled for June.
sentences.zh: 在国际紧张局势和国内不满情绪交织的格外动荡时刻，这两位具有影响力的领导人的离世让该国失去了主心骨。

sentences.en: Iranian state media reported on Monday that the crash happened because of a, quote, technical failure.
sentences.zh: 伊朗官方媒体周一报道称，坠机事故是因为所谓的“技术故障”造成的。

sentences.en: The deaths leave the country without two influential leaders at a particularly tumultuous moment of international tension and domestic discontent.
sentences.zh: 在国际紧张局势和国内不满情绪交织的格外动荡时刻，这两位具有影响力的领导人的离世让该国失去了主心骨。

sentences.en: Although analysts and regional officials expect little change in Iran's foreign or domestic policies.
sentences.zh: 尽管分析人士和地方官员预计伊朗的外交或国内政策不会有什么改变。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Will Reed, Olivia Natt, Jessica Chung, and Asla Chaturvedi.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由威尔·里德、奥利维亚·纳特、杰西卡·钟和阿斯拉·查图维迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klinkenberg and Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·克林肯伯格和丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德担任音响工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔维内西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严格控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
